move: four beats: type slams, marquee cut, lime stripes, product spins
how: Beat 1 (0-0.15D): shot 1 punches from scale 1.3 to 1.1 with power2.out while the logo and 'Go' snap up from masks and 'Harder' slides in from xPercent 120. Beat 2 (0.15D): hard cut via autoAlpha set to shot 2 which pans xPercent 3→-3 and scales to 1.15 linearly, a marquee bar races in from the right with expo.out, its text scrolls xPercent 0→-30, then the bar exits left with expo.in. Beat 3 (0.32D): a lime solid appears, two stripes slash in from opposite sides, 'Season' snaps up and 'Four' snaps down, then stripes and type shove out with expo.in. Beat 4 (0.49D): shot 3 drifts while an SVG shoe spins in from rotation -30 scale 0.4 y:300 with expo.out, lifts to y:-640 at 0.6D, two stat rows and a CTA rise, the CTA pulses scale 1.04 four times. At 0.93D everything exits and shot 3 fades so the loop hard-cuts back to shot 1.
adapt: Replace the three shot images and filters, the word pairs per beat, the marquee text, product SVG, stat values and CTA; keep the beat boundaries (1.5, 3.2, 4.9s of 10) and the 0.45s expo.out snaps for the pace.
port: mount(el, shot) builds three .shot layers, .solid, stripes, logo, .big words, .bar marquee, .prod, stats and .cta, applying the initial autoAlpha hides; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with beat offsets as fractions of D (1.5/10, 3.2/10, 4.9/10, exit 9.3/10). Scope selectors to el.
caveats: three full-frame background images with CSS filters
from() tweens need immediateRender:false when rebuilt
